verdict.rationale: The New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services is a state business-registry and filing service, not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence suggests it runs an agent or consumes MCP tools; the material covers only filings, certificates, notices and record searches.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
